title: Communion cards
lead: Holy Supper is on the second Sunday of each month. The Church Elders sign the month and note contributions; the secretariat proposes cards and a second person approves them. A member only sees what is expected, never a debt.
no_access: You have access to no part of this page.
empty_p: Propose a first card from “New card”.
suspend_p: The person will see “Card suspended, see the pastor”, with no reason.
renew_p: The card stays valid until the chosen date; the old QR code stops working.
withdraw_p: The card is withdrawn. The reason stays in the activity log, never shown to the person.
error: That could not be done. Try again.
second_person: A different person than the one who proposed the card must approve it.
new_p: Find the person. If the baptism register confirms it, click “Confirm baptism”, then propose the card: another person will have to approve it.
fees_p: What is expected by age band and by group. A member only sees this expected amount, never a balance. Leave empty to expect nothing.
check_p: Scan a card’s QR code with the camera, or paste the address it contains. Nothing is kept outside the activity log.
camera_label: Camera to read the QR code
camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Paste the address instead.
intro_cards_p: Pick the month: for each card you see whether it is valid, whether the month is signed and what was received. The Elders sign and note here, on Holy Supper Sunday and during the preparation week; the pastor approves new cards.
intro_new_p: Three steps: 1) confirm the baptism from the register, 2) propose the card, 3) another person approves it. The list below already shows the members who declared their baptism and wait for your confirmation; search to find someone else.
intro_fees_p: One amount per age band and per group. The member sees it as a guide (“expected”), never a debt, and nothing is refused if it is not paid. Leave empty to expect nothing.
intro_check_t: Checking a card at the entrance.
intro_check_p: Scan the card’s QR code or paste its address: you see whether it is valid.
search_hint: Name, e-mail or phone. Leave empty to see the baptisms to confirm.
pending_p: These members declared they are baptised or confirmed. Check the baptism register, then confirm.
pending_empty_p: When a member declares their baptism in their profile, they will appear here.
help_lead: This page manages Communion cards: who has one, who signed this month and what was received. Holy Supper is on the second Sunday of each month; the preparation week is the one before (Monday to Saturday).
help_tabs_1_p: The month’s work. One line per card: status, month’s visa, contribution received, actions. Used by the Elders, the secretariat, the pastor and the treasurer.
help_tabs_2_p: To create a card: confirm the baptism, then propose. Used by the secretariat and the pastor.
help_tabs_3_p: The amounts expected by age band and by group. Edited by the treasurer; read by the others.
help_tabs_4_p: The scanner: to check a card’s QR code at the Holy Supper entrance.
help_states_1_p: The card is proposed but not valid yet. A different person than the one who proposed it must approve it. The member does not see it yet.
help_states_2_p: The member sees their card and QR code. The month can be signed and contributions noted.
help_states_3_p: The card stops working (the QR says “not valid”). The member sees “see the pastor”, never the reason. It can be restored.
help_states_4_p: The validity date has passed. Renew it for the new year.
help_states_5_p: The pastor removed the card. The member no longer has one. The reason stays in the activity log.
help_actions_1_p: You checked in the baptism register that the person is baptised. Without it, no card can be proposed.
help_actions_2_p: Creates the card, valid until the end of the year. It stays “to approve”.
help_actions_3_p: Second person: makes the card valid. You cannot approve a card you proposed.
help_actions_4_p: The Elders’ signature for the chosen month’s Holy Supper. The member sees it on their card and their streak grows. “Remove the visa” fixes a mistake.
help_actions_5_p: Enter the amount received this month. The member never sees this register: only what is expected. Nothing is refused if it is not paid.
help_actions_6_p: Pauses the card (secretariat), then restores it. For a temporary pastoral case.
help_actions_7_p: Extends the card for a new period (pastor). The old QR code stops working.
help_actions_8_p: Removes the card (pastor), with a reason kept in the log. Keep it for definitive cases.
help_scenarios_1_p:
1. The member declares their baptism in their profile.
2. New card: they appear in “Baptisms to confirm”. Check the register, then “Confirm baptism”.
3. “Propose a card”.
4. The pastor opens Cards, finds “To approve” and clicks “Approve”.
help_scenarios_2_p:
1. Cards: choose the current month.
2. For each person who took communion and prepared: “Sign the month”.
3. Note the contribution received, if given.
4. A member shown “Excused” told you themselves: their streak is paused, nothing to do.
help_scenarios_3_p: Filter “Expired” or search for the person, then More › Renew and choose the new date. Cards are renewed with a second person: the pastor.
help_scenarios_4_p: Check a card › Open the camera and aim at the member’s QR code (or paste the address). “Valid card” or “Card not valid” shows, with the first name.
help_scenarios_5_t: Someone should no longer take communion
help_scenarios_5_p:
For a pause: More › Suspend (the member sees “see the pastor”), then Restore later.
For a definitive case: the pastor chooses More › Withdraw, with a reason.
